Display scale (%)
Over 100 the game gets fewer pixels, each one larger (150: two thirds as many lines); under 100 more, up to the app\'s limit of 2100 x 900 pixels, which most phones reach at 100
A pad\'s buttons the app\'s gamepad controls do not use are not passed to the game as keys; the controls themselves stay on
The stylus moves the pointer and clicks as a mouse does, without pressure, angle or tilt
The stylus button gives a right or middle click only while the stylus touches the screen
Every move of a mouse or touchpad goes to the game; Escape gives the pointer back to Android
Accessibility service for system shortcuts
Opens Android\'s Accessibility settings: turn on \"Beyond All Reason keyboard shortcuts\" there
Turn that service on automatically
Needs the WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS permission (granted over adb)
Leave the Win (Meta) key to DeX
DeX\'s own Win key shortcuts keep working while the others go to the game; needs the Accessibility service
On-screen keyboard with a hardware keyboard
The soft keyboard still opens while a hardware keyboard is connected
A hardware keyboard\'s keys go as key codes, read with the X server\'s layout (US) instead of Android\'s
The phone\'s clipboard and the game\'s are shared both ways
What swipes and keys do
What swipes and keys do
Swipes (with BAR touch controls off), the volume and media keys; Back is always Escape in the game
Clipboard, what swipes and the volume keys do
The game over the whole screen: Android\'s status and navigation bars hidden until a swipe from the edge
Touchscreen input mode (with BAR touch controls off)
Display filtering mode (with Sharper upscaling off)
Trackpad mode only: a tap clicks a moment later, and a tap then a held finger drags
With BAR touch controls off, a display zoomed in by a pinch moves along with the pointer
The game also fills the screen around the camera\'s hole; off, it stops short of that edge (a black strip there)

Update BAR at every start\nLike BAR\'s PC launcher: engine, game, lobby; back to the last working version if an update fails to start. Off: only the Install / Update button updates
Phone engine\nBAR\'s engine built for phones: the touch and pad controls in every game, the phone Settings, faster skirmishes and replays. Off: BAR\'s official engine

Game resolution\nOf the game\'s picture (up to about 900 lines, enlarged to the screen); lower runs cooler. Native: the screen\'s own, the heaviest
Native
Frame cap\nThe most frames drawn a second; 30 keeps the phone cooler and the picture steady, no cap runs it hot
30 fps
60 fps
No cap
Sharper upscaling (Qualcomm SGSR)\nThe game is drawn smaller than the screen and enlarged; SGSR keeps edges sharp where plain enlarging blurs them
Compare upscaling (diagnostic)\nSGSR on and off every 3 seconds, with a label
Lower the resolution when fps drops\nUnder 27 fps the game is drawn smaller a step at a time, down to 70% of the render resolution, only while each step helps; the upscaling enlarges it
Lobby bridge\nThe app stands in for BAR\'s PC launcher, for the Replays tab, web links and skill ratings; the lobby\'s downloads go through the app. Off: the Replays tab cannot list replays
BAR touch controls\nDrag pans, pinch zooms, twist rotates, two fingers up or down tilt, tap then drag selects, long press gives orders (then drag: a path). Off: the touch modes under Display

Play upright (portrait)\nThe lobby and the game upright while they do not turn with the phone: the game on top, a touch dock below: a camera pad, the build grid, orders, metal and energy, the groups. Its taps and drags are in the README
Turn with the phone\nWith the phone\'s auto-rotate on, the lobby and the game turn upright or sideways as you hold the phone, at any time. With auto-rotate off, Play upright decides

Touch dock sideways\nHeld sideways, the touch dock at one side of the bottom, for one thumb: the minimap with metal and energy, and beside it BUILD | ORDERS tabs for the units picked (a sideways swipe changes the tab), the home buttons with nothing picked; the arrow moves the dock to the other side. A gamepad or mouse brings back BAR\'s own screen
Map storage\nDownloaded maps are kept under this; before a game starts the ones played longest ago are deleted, and download again when a game needs them

Keyboard shortcuts go to the game\nAlt+Tab, the Windows key, Ctrl+Space and the soft keyboard\'s language switch reach BAR while it is in front, not Android, One UI or DeX. Off: Android\'s own
Beyond All Reason keyboard shortcuts

Optional. Sends the keyboard shortcuts Android would take for itself (Alt+Tab, the Windows key, Ctrl+Space) to Beyond All Reason while its game screen is in front. Needed only where Android does not hand them to the game by itself (before Android 16.1). It reads keys only while the game screen has focus and passes them to the game; Home, Recents, power and volume keys stay Android\'s.
Proot without seccomp acceleration\nEvery system call of the game stops in proot: much slower; only to test whether its filter breaks something (PROOT_NO_SECCOMP)
Verbose X server logging\nThe display server\'s (Termux:X11) debug output in the log
